Karcher JE Saddle Tower

Karcher JE Saddle Tower is a doubly periodic minimal surface, given by a Weierstrass representation, immersed, with a layer group.

Definition

Doubly periodic embedded minimal surfaces parametrized by rectangular tori, from Karcher's 1988 Scherk-example constructions; the shape can be viewed as a doubly periodic version of Riemann's minimal surface.
